title: Verified fund holdings versus a binding concentration limit
initial_observation: IF an operative fund/class mandate sets a precisely defined issuer or group concentration cap applicable at a stated test time, and dated disclosed positions can be attributed to that exact exposure group.
expected_observation: THEN calculate the exposure using the mandate’s numerator/denominator and timing rules, reconcile corrections and permitted exceptions, and identify only unresolved excesses—not a breach from a raw portfolio percentage.
basis: A material deviation from a binding investment limit can expose investors to risk they did not agree to bear. If the measure is strictly additive and nonnegative, verified disclosed exposure alone can provide a lower bound even with confidential positions. A low lower bound never proves compliance; no universal CVM cap or cure deadline is asserted.
operational_join: CVM CNPJ_FUNDO_CLASSE plus DT_COMPTC → exact fund/class registry and operative mandate → issuer ID in the appropriate CDA block (CNPJ_EMISSOR or typed CPF_CNPJ_EMISSOR) or verified security crosswalk → VL_MERC_POS_FINAL and correctly scoped VL_PATRIM_LIQ or other prescribed denominator. CD_ISIN occurs in some blocks only. OpenFIGI is optional instrument mapping, not proof of issuer group/control. Do not conflate fund, class and subclass.
temporal_geographic_scope: Brazilian regulated fund/class and dated mandate; same competence date and valuation basis. An acquisition-time cap cannot be tested from end-month positions alone. Confirm passive market-movement exceptions, transition/cure windows, special fund classes and whether exposure is gross, net, look-through or issuer-group based.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Wrong fund/class or mandate version", "Cap applies only at acquisition", "Permitted passive exceedance or cure period", "Netting/hedges or look-through change prescribed exposure", "Wrong issuer grouping", "Confidential aggregate double-counted with released detail", "Liabilities make NAV differ from assets", "Corrected filing or valuation basis", "Identifier lost leading zeros or person mistaken for company"]
mandatory_evidence: ["Operative fund/class mandate and relevant dated rules", "Class/fund registration mapping", "Dated holdings and filing revisions; one selected vintage, original-file hashes and row locators; reviewed canonical holding identity across row aliases; aggregate/detail reconciliation (helper accepts individual positions only)", "Verified issuer/security/group identity", "Same-basis positive denominator and conservative upper bound; per-position exposure lower bounds or documented rounding/measurement tolerances", "Applicable exceptions and transaction history when needed"]
next_cheapest_check: Read the exact cap and its timing/measurement rule first. Then inspect a single dated disclosed position and class denominator. Stop if the mandate cannot be tied to that class or the exposure cannot be measured without unsupported netting assumptions.
novelty_comparison: F03 compares aggregate exposure/liquidity categories; X14 compares supposedly identical statements. This tests binding portfolio constraints against positions. One-source CVM routes may suffice; optional OpenFIGI mapping is not counted as another independent test.
access_evidence: A 10,094-byte CVM metadata ZIP was downloaded and parsed; no holdings were downloaded. It confirms relevant field names and block differences. Mandate retrieval, actual class crosswalk, complete exposure and any exception remain unverified.

title: A precise records-custody assertion against authenticated dated evidence
initial_observation: IF an original agency response makes a specific factual assertion that an identified record was never created, received or held within a defined scope/date, and authenticated evidence appears to show the same agency component held that exact record during that scope.
expected_observation: THEN compare the full request, clarification, search cutoff, response wording and actual custody evidence, considering referrals, corrections and search methods before describing a contradiction.
basis: Contradictory custody claims can justify further reporting or a reviewable follow-up. A no-records search result is not a statement that a record never existed, and finding an overlooked record alone does not establish legal inadequacy, concealment or bad faith.
operational_join: MuckRock request ID → actual agency case number and full response → exact document/control number or authenticated content identity → agency component/custodian and proven control date. State Department reading-room case IDs are not automatically MuckRock request IDs. Court docket/exhibit may supply authenticated custody evidence, subject to availability.
temporal_geographic_scope: Request scope and relevant control/search dates, not merely publication or archive capture date. An older public document does not establish continued custody; lawful transfer/destruction, later acquisition and different components require review.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Response merely says search found nothing", "Different record/version or agency component", "Outside agreed scope/date", "Document acquired later or no longer held", "Referral or link to public record instead of new production", "Valid exclusion/Glomar handling", "Corrected reply or adequate reasonable search despite missed record"]
mandatory_evidence: ["Full request and all clarifications", "Original complete response/search declaration", "Exact record identity", "Authenticated agency control at relevant time", "Applicable procedural context and amendments"]
next_cheapest_check: Read the exact response wording first. Reject a supposed contradiction if it only reports a search result. Then demand record identity and dated custody evidence before any legal inference; no new request is sent.
novelty_comparison: Refinement of precise-assertion checking with D04/N05 records-access routes. Kept outside new-mechanism totals; not a redaction comparison or a blanket no-records failure detector.
access_evidence: DOJ guidance was inspected, including its distinction between reasonable search methods and results. No request-response/document pair acquired; no agency contact or paid court access.

title: A fund’s explicit connected-issuer flag versus dated control evidence
initial_observation: IF a disclosed position expressly marks the issuer as not connected to the manager/administrator, and independently verified dated control evidence appears to meet the applicable definition of connection.
expected_observation: THEN reconcile the precise legal entities, role, control dates and reporting definition before identifying an unresolved flag inconsistency.
basis: Potentially undisclosed related-party exposure matters, but a shared service provider, similar name or common address is not control. The field is a filing assertion, not an independently validated relationship.
operational_join: CDA fund/class CNPJ and issuer identifier → manager/administrator entity and CNPJ → official corporate control documents or GLEIF legal-registration/parent crosswalk. LEI, issuer CNPJ and manager CNPJ are distinct roles and namespaces; parent-reporting exceptions and gaps matter.
temporal_geographic_scope: Position date, control effective interval and definition in force for that fund class. Do not apply a generic connectedness or beneficial-ownership percentage.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Shared service provider without legal connection", "Different affiliate or date", "Accounting parent differs from applicable control", "Corrected flag", "Different reporting definition", "Incomplete GLEIF parent coverage"]
mandatory_evidence: ["Original position flag", "Manager/administrator identity", "Applicable definition", "Dated underlying control documents", "Corrections and filing history"]
next_cheapest_check: Confirm the exact meaning of EMISSOR_LIGADO and identify the manager before querying ownership. Do not infer a flag error from a common custodian.
novelty_comparison: Refinement of X04 disclosure consistency and E08 related-party verification. Useful new implementation route, not a new mechanism count.
access_evidence: Metadata confirms the flag exists in multiple blocks. No actual flag, manager or control record matched; legal definition is unresolved.

title: Claimed independent corroboration that reuses one underlying source
initial_observation: IF a high-consequence published synthesis expressly treats multiple reports as independent corroboration, and full provenance suggests those reports derive from one underlying witness, document or press statement.
expected_observation: THEN reconstruct the reporting chain and each report’s independent contribution, and reassess only the stated corroboration claim after collapsing demonstrably shared evidence.
basis: Counting repetitions as independent evidence can overstate confidence. Syndication alone does not prove the underlying event false, and a reused article can contain new independent reporting.
operational_join: GDELT source URL and time → Media Cloud story URL/date → actual full article, citations and original source → archived version where available. URL equality, content digest or event-ID overlap is a clue, not proof of the same witness or independent reporting.
temporal_geographic_scope: Version and publication chronology of the synthesis and source reports; source access and archival completeness must be established. Different datasets may intentionally report different units of one event.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Article adds original reporting", "Same event confirmed by different witnesses", "Synthesis never claims independence", "Wire service reports independently verified later", "Missing original obscures chain", "Different event/claim units"]
mandatory_evidence: ["Exact independence claim", "Full articles and referenced originals", "Documented reporting/provenance chain", "Evidence of each independent contribution", "Original versus updated versions"]
next_cheapest_check: Trace two cited reports to their stated originals before counting sources. If the original source cannot be established, mark dependence unknown rather than assuming either independence or duplication.
novelty_comparison: Refinement of X11 evidence independence; switching from overlapping trial participants to reused reporting is not counted as a new mechanism. No plagiarism or fabrication inference.
access_evidence: Catalog fields support URL/date leads only; no articles fetched or provenance chain demonstrated. Full-text access remains unverified.
